split_basis: calendar midpoint frozen before downloading; launch < split H1 else H2
entry: next 1m open at signal due; 20bp adverse; stop/TP relative to un-slipped reference open, matching ask-reference levels
stop_gap: worse of stop and candle open, then 20bp adverse
horizon: launchTime + 24h; close last complete candle at horizon with taker fee; no extra terminal slip
short: same A5 positive-growth signal, reversed position; no negative-growth refilter
control: 5 completed bars, same turnover threshold, remove growth and close confirmation, LONG; secondary control retains close confirmation only
unavailable: historical BBO spread, ask depth, lot filters at launch, poll delay and tradability of zero-volume candles cannot be reconstructed
funding: historical realized rates and 1m close mark proxy at payment time; missing or empty history explicitly unknown, not zero
universe: all USDT LinearPerpetual returned for default/Trading/Settled/Delivering/Closed/PreLaunch/PendingOpen statuses; crypto subset matching monitor reported separately
